events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Start the work and secure data access
attendees: Plant Directors of the six plants
events.decision: Confirm access to cost data and plant teams at all six plants?
agenda: Present the engagement objective, phases and steering meetings
Align on how cost per part is measured across the six plants
Confirm access to cost data and plant teams at all six plants

events.label: Workshop 1: baselines
attendees: Plant Directors of the six plants
events.decision: Which plants go forward as pilot candidates for the go/no-go pack?
agenda: Present the cost-per-part baselines for all six plants
Review the loss map for the first two plants
Decide which plants go forward as pilot candidates

events.label: Initiative go/no-go
events.purpose: Decide go/no-go and the pilot plant
attendees: Plant Directors of the six plants
events.decision: Go or no-go on the sized improvements, and which plant pilots them first?
agenda: Present the sized improvements by plant
Review the go/no-go pack and the pilot plant options
Decide go or no-go and which plant pilots first

events.label: Workshop 2: pilot readiness
attendees: Plant Directors of the six plants
events.decision: Go or no-go on taking the change plan live at the pilot plant?
agenda: Present the pilot plant change plan
Review readiness gaps in the change plan before go-live
Decide go or no-go on going live at the pilot plant

events.label: Check-in: pilot results
events.purpose: Review pilot results and set up wave 1
attendees: Plant Directors of the six plants
events.decision: Keep or adjust the wave 1 rollout plan, given the pilot savings shown?
agenda: Review the operating pilot and the pilot plant savings
Present the cost-per-part tracker by plant
Decide whether to keep or adjust the wave 1 rollout plan

events.label: Workshop 3: wave 1 review
attendees: Plant Directors of the six plants
events.decision: Go or no-go on starting wave 2 in the remaining plants?
agenda: Review wave 1 operating improvements and training record
Discuss what the final readout must show for each plant
Decide go or no-go on starting wave 2

events.label: Final readout
attendees: Plant Directors of the six plants
events.decision: Approve the final results and the running improvements in all six plants?
agenda: Present the final readout pack with results by plant
Review wave 2 operating improvements and training record
Decide on approval of the final results and running improvements
